sections.title: Progress report template
sections.html:
Progress report template

The one-page report each family gets after week 4 and after week 8. Fill it in from your class notes and the app, then send it within two days.

How to fill it in (for the instructor)

  • Use real numbers only. Scores come from the drill pages and the app. If you did not record it, leave it out.
  • One strength, one next step. Name a move, not a trait. "Sets three-digit numbers from the left without looking at her fingers" beats "She's so smart."
  • Praise the move said out loud more than the right answer. That is the habit that carries into the next stage.
  • No comparisons with other kids in the class.
  • Keep it short. A parent should read it in one minute.
  • Week 4 covers Stage 1 (Sprout). Week 8 covers Stage 2 (Explorer) and adds the next step.

Abacus class progress report

Child: FIRST NAME Report: ☐ Week 4 ☐ Week 8 Instructor: YOUR NAME, Certified Phenom Instructor Date: DATE

Where FIRST NAME is now

Stage: ☐ 1 Sprout (meet the beads) ☐ 2 Explorer (small friends)

Lessons done in the app: of 8 in this stage

Classes attended: of

Home practice: about days a week (from the app)

What FIRST NAME can do

Tick each one you have seen in class.

Stage 1 (Sprout)

  • ☐ Clears the abacus and uses thumb up, pointer down
  • ☐ Reads a three-digit number in under 3 seconds
  • ☐ Sets a three-digit number from the left
  • ☐ Adds and takes away on one rod when the beads are free
  • ☐ Works a two-digit sum left to right, tens first
  • ☐ Sees a number with eyes closed and says it

Stage 2 (Explorer), week 8 only

  • ☐ Asks "free beads, or friend?" before moving
  • ☐ Uses the four adding friends (+1, +2, +3, +4)
  • ☐ Uses the four take-away friends (−1, −2, −3, −4)
  • ☐ Works a four-line, two-digit sum with friends
  • ☐ Adds three small numbers in the head

Scores

CheckScoreTarget
Best drill page this block of 9 of 10
Boss practice in class☐ Passed ☐ Not yetAll three parts
Boss test in the app☐ Passed ☐ Not yetAll three parts

"Not yet" is normal. The boss is meant to be hard, and a second or third try at home is part of the plan.

One thing FIRST NAME does well

[One sentence. Name the move.]

One thing to work on next

[One sentence. Name the move and how to practise it.]

At home this month

  • 15 minutes a day, same time, with you beside. Stop while it is still fun.
  • When FIRST NAME gets stuck, ask "free beads, or friend?" and wait. Do not touch the beads.
  • [Week 4 only] Try the daily quest "Read 3-digit numbers" in the app.
  • [Week 8 only] Keep the daily quest "Friend or free?" going until the next course starts.

What comes next (week 8 only)

The next course is Stage 3 (Apprentice). It teaches how to carry and borrow on the beads. It starts DATE at TIME. Reply "next" to hold FIRST NAME's seat.

For more practice at home, the free kit page at childphenoms.com/free-abacus leads to Phenom University. It has a 14-day free test drive, and one membership covers every child in your house.

Questions? Text me at PHONE.

YOUR NAME
